transcript: The fastest way to fail with AI is chasing every new tool that launches. I see so many people trying to master everything and stay on top of every single tool that's coming out. And by the time they master that tool, another tool comes onto the market. What we do is we just take a small piece of that tool and master that and go deep in that. And what we do is we take business owners' old leads and we turn them into sales using AI and SMS, right? So we get very good at that small slice of AI, that small slice of the tool that just works over and over again, and it will work again for many years. So the trick is not to go broad and learn every single product or every single AI solution out there. It's just to master one small thing with a timeless pain point for a client. And if you can do that, then you're not gonna get outdated.
